Its initial DLSS-seeded synthetic color edge blended during output reconstruction; all six initial failures and captures are retained separately. The corrected fixture retains the 0.02 leakage tolerance; dedicated DLSS evaluation checks are separate.

Prior branch validation is retained with its own runtime hashes and is not added to current acceptance totals.
